decisions.reason: s0104 has 僧格林沁、勝保; 勝 is shèng, so 勝保 is Shengbao. Sengbao wrongly echoes 僧 from Senggelinqin; the proposed idiomatic corrects only that name.
The same Chinese 勝保 requires Shengbao in the literal field. Sengbao misreads 勝; the proposed replacement is accurate and otherwise unchanged.
